notes: Triple homonym: shares consonants צלל with already-shipped H6750 ("tingle; quiver", צלל¹) and H6751 ("grow dark", צלל²). Both of those roots' own notes already anticipated this root's arrival and named it צלל³ in advance (ascending-Strong's-number order among the three, even though H6749 is numerically the lowest -- ¹ and ² were already assigned to the other two before this root existed, so it takes the next available superscript rather than triggering a renumbering).

Gloss collision: "sink" is already used by H8257 (שקע, "sink; die down"), a genuinely different root. Not a blocker per the maintenance guide -- disambiguating transliteration "(tzalal)" added to search_match only.
